items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was with Ludwig since the late ’40s. That’s when I went with Ludwig. 1948, maybe.

ctx.x: When did you – since we know that you were playing on the tabletops, etc., did you study it formally? Did you take drum lessons?

I studied later – I studied maybe 1944, at Boston Conservatory, because it was fashionable. I remember the teacher’s name was Karl Ludwig. He was an old German teacher, very legitimate. I learned nothing there. I went because it sounded good, Boston Conservatory.
So you were able to go to Boston Conservatory? You hadn’t finished high school.
